item.title: Gambonanza Build Guide v1.1.0 - All Archetypes from Pawn Economy to Queen Supremacy
item.description:
Not every build works in every run. The best Gambonanza players know how to read the shop and adapt. This guide covers the 5 major build archetypes in v1.1.0, when to build each one, and how to transition between them.

Don’t force a build. Read what the shop gives you and pivot. A flexible player with a B-tier build that fits their gambits will beat a rigid player forcing S-tier without the right cards.

Build 1: Pawn Economy Loop S-Tier

Best for: Consistent runs, learning the game, King difficulty grinding

item.title: Queen Supremacy Guide
item.description:
Queen Supremacy-TL;DR Check All Gambits Guide for the full breakdown. The Rook & Bishop Guide breaks this down in detail.

Deploy Queen on turn 2-4 (not turn 1, not turn 10).

Pair her with 1 Gambit. Win.

SHighest-impact piece per stock. Naked Queen = expensive target. Queen + 1 Gambit = game over.

When to Deploy-3-Board Cheat Sheet

Board Deploy on Turn Why
4x4 2-3 Overkill, but Teleport combo ends game in 2 turns
5x5 2-4 Sweet spot-deploy early, stack Gambits
6x6+ 3-5 Clear a lane first, then Queen takes over

Rule: Never turn 1 on 5x5+. Deploy Knight/Bishop first to open a lane.
